analysis.problem_hypothesis: Callback and booking enquiries may require manual qualification by repair type, city, urgency, and missing details.
analysis.solution: Develop an automated enquiry qualification process leveraging existing public evidence and a structured data model.
inputs: Existing MobileMistri data (city, repair type, urgency, missing details)
analysis.processing: Implement a system that analyzes incoming enquiry data and automatically flags potential qualification requirements based on predefined criteria (repair type, city, urgency, missing details).
outputs: Automated qualification flags for each enquiry record
analysis.business_value: Improved efficiency in handling customer inquiries, reduced manual effort, and enhanced data quality, ultimately leading to better service delivery and customer satisfaction.
